doc: slope -2 and low 0: a rising spectrum (amplitude = radius), and the DC mode gets the guarded radius 1e-9 instead of 0 (amplitude 1e-9, removed again by the mean). Exercises the negative exponent and the DC guard together. low <= 0 with a positive slope is NOT a case: the DC amplitude 3e13 makes the result numerically meaningless (error 8e-3). The white noise the seed draws is the input plan0.white (size, size). FFT convention: numpy fft2 unnormalized forward, ifft2 divides by size^2, k = fftfreq(size) * size. Measured: every random input nudged by one float64 ulp (8 trials) and numpy.fft replaced by scipy.fft: max |diff| 1.8e-15 (6e-13 relative on values above 1e-3), so 1e-9 relative / 1e-10 absolute.
